criteria.text: Removed names containing "@octocat", "#17", "Closes #17", spaces and backticks appear as quoted JSON literals in Markdown code spans, with their raw identity and source order preserved.

Kept test names and complete changed assertion lines containing Markdown, HTML, mentions, issue references and backticks use code spans longer than every interior backtick run, without HTML entity substitution.
New suite and test skip entries use the same code-span format, preserve leading and trailing spaces, and show carriage returns, controls and bidirectional formatting characters as JSON escapes.

Names and source lines containing "pdd-workflow:" show every matching prefix colon as "\u003a" inside their code spans, so the exact text can be recovered without becoming a workflow marker; later colons and different capitalization stay unchanged.
